# `adt flow`

Materialize incremental ADT source-tree boundaries

```bash
adt flow [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                                |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt flow checkout` | Reconcile a source tree to an ADT boundary                 |
| `adt flow index`    | Persist transport inventory without source materialization |

## `adt flow checkout`

Reconcile a source tree to an ADT boundary

```bash
adt flow checkout [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                | Description                                            |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt flow checkout tr` | Checkout the exact source-tree boundary for transports |

### `adt flow checkout tr`

Checkout the exact source-tree boundary for transports

```bash
adt flow checkout tr [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                                         | Default |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number or comma-separated transport scope |         |

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                                                                | Default |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--base`                  | Checkout the version immediately before the scope                          |         |
| `--partial`               | Materialize only objects with exact source-history boundaries              |         |
| `--partial-report <file>` | Write skipped-object JSON after a successful partial checkout              |         |
| `--report <file>`         | Write inventory and materialization evidence after a successful checkout   |         |
| `--index-on-inexact`      | Persist source-free inventory when an exact source boundary is unavailable |         |

## `adt flow index`

Persist transport inventory without source materialization

```bash
adt flow index [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                            |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt flow index tr` | Index transport inventory without materializing source |

### `adt flow index tr`

Index transport inventory without materializing source

```bash
adt flow index tr [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                                         | Default |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number or comma-separated transport scope |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
